segments.text: Kojirou's ex-girlfriend. Head of the Katsuragi Detective Agency.
Wild and subtle, self-titled "Super Top-Notch Detective."

A private detective. Once belonged to the Katsuragi Detective Office, where he solved many difficult cases and made a name for himself as a great detective. But a certain incident compelled him to leave the office behind and try making his own detective office at the dock area in a run-down warehouse, which he still owns.

He's no good at desk work, and is more adept at using his own head to investigate. His skills didn't completely decline over the time while work was rare to come by. He's rather loose when it comes to women.

A brilliant (trouble-making?) international agent. Even though she boasts a 99% success rate, she is alienated by various officials because she wreaks havoc wherever she goes. She served abroad for awhile, but has returned to Japan after a long absence. Her best friend since ages ago is Yayoi, from the Katsuragi Private Detective Agency.

segments.text: Eldia's Prime Minister
One of Kojirou's acquaintances. A journalist who brings Kojirou his first case in months.
An employee at the Katsuragi Detective Agency.
Daughter of Ross Midou, the Kingdom of Eldia's Ambassador. Marina was hired to protect her from terrorist attacks.
Because of her dad's constant travels between Eldia and Japan, she has almost no time to make friends, and is quite reserved as a result.
Actually a genetic clone of Purin/Prisia and only about a year old. She was created to serve as a vessel for the King of Eldia's consciousness.
College student who works part-time at Yale International Academy's Library and as a teacher for the school.
Insurance investigator who met Marina during one of her missions.
A girl Kojirou saves from a group of hooligans.
